_comment: Mainnet deployment manifest. Single source of truth for which version is live for each contract and where to find the full artifact. Updated on every mainnet deploy. The indexer / backend should read this file (or its raw URL on GitHub) to discover what to track. Per-file artifacts under this directory remain the authoritative record for config + roles for a given version; this index just answers 'what's live now and where do I find it'.

platform._note: V6 = the AuthHub era: full fresh platform (delegated bets via AuthHub session keys). Only the EVA token carries over. V5 contracts are retired and emptied; their addresses stay in the V5 artifact + the legacy block of arb-mainnet-v6.json for historical reads (e.g. the old MLR referral tree).

games._comment: For each game: the currently-live deployment artifact and on-chain address. New games or version bumps register here on deploy.

ticketLottery._note: TicketLottery talks to Chainlink VRF coordinator directly, NOT via the platform RandomProvider. It does not inherit BaseGame and does not emit IGameEvents envelope events. Indexers wanting to track lottery draws should subscribe to LotteryRequested / LotteryFulfilled directly. Previous standalone lottery: 0x46dedcca913facb6f6fab4191b25de34c8e9cb57 (lottery-mainnet.json).

ancillaryArtifacts._comment: Non-deployment files in this directory (lottery results, airdrop ledgers, etc.). Listed here so consumers know they exist; not part of the live contract graph.
